question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**seen**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context of the passage is about perceptions and misconceptions related to child obesity.
 
• The word to fill the blank should imply how parents perceive or regard obesity in their children.
 
• "**Seen**" is appropriate as it aligns with the idea of how something is viewed or perceived.
 
• Other options ("**saw**", "**seeing**", "**see**") do not fit grammatically or contextually in this sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Many parents think of overweight children as ‘cute’ and cuddly. However, obesity must not be 1.* *seen__* *as a healthy sign. 2. __**As**__ obese children grow up, they will be more prone 3. __**to**__ health problems like high blood pressure 4. __**and**__ diabetes. Today, overweight children are becoming a common 5. __**sight**__ in many countries.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Seen (देखा गया): "Seen" is correct as it indicates how obesity should be regarded or considered.
 
• Saw (देखा): “Saw” is the past tense of see and does not fit the tense and structure of the sentence.
 
• Seeing (देखना): “Seeing” is the present participle and does not fit the grammatical context here.
 
• See (देखना): “See” is the base form of the verb and does not fit the context of how obesity is regarded.
